content.title: Fair Isaac Corporation (NYSE:FICO) Reports Q3 CY2025 In Line With Expectations
content.summary: Credit scoring and analytics company FICO (NYSE:FICO) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 13.6% year on year to $515.8 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $2.35 billion at the midpoint came in 1.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.74 per share was 5.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
